sonnet.problem: The joke repeats the punchline shape of card 9. Card 9 says he opens the oven door FOUR times, and card 17 says his oven timer rings THREE times. Both are a number of times he fails to leave the oven alone. The card 17 comparison is also weak. The text says only that Moses did as commanded, with no mention of speed or delay, so an oven timer ringing before Papa Dorin looks up doesn't match that action and may leave a baker saying 'huh?'.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
